official.deadline_note: The application period for the PhD Track program runs from October to January; the dates for the next session will be announced on the official website
official.status_note: IP Paris awards excellence scholarships each year to PhD Track students; the application period runs from October to January with next-session dates announced on the website
official.tuition_coverage_note: Tuition fees are subsidized separately for all admitted PhD Track students whether or not they hold a scholarship: years 1 and 2 reduced from approximately €7,000 per year to €243 per year, and years 3, 4 and 5 set at €380 per year (official 2023-2024 MESR rates, subject to change by decree)
official.funding_period: per year for up to 2 years
benefits: Master's excellence scholarship of €10,000 per year for 2 years (or 1 year)

Full Package (FP): 5-year (or 4-year) funding combining the Master's excellence scholarship with a doctoral funding commitment for 3 years, a total minimum gross funding of approximately €82,800 over 3 years
Master's Scholarship (BM): 2-year (or 1-year) funding consisting only of the Master's excellence scholarship
Doctoral Package (DP): 3-year doctoral funding commitment covering only the doctoral studies, a total minimum gross funding of approximately €82,800 over 3 years
Reduced tuition for all admitted PhD Track students, whether or not they receive a scholarship
Doctoral funding with a monthly salary for PhD Track students
eligibility: Admitted to a PhD Track program at Institut Polytechnique de Paris
Candidates must hold a Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) to enter at M1 level, or an M1 certificate of completion (or equivalent, 180 ECTS + 60 ECTS) to enter at M2 level
Applicants must be fluent in English, have an excellent academic background and wish to become researchers
Best candidates are eligible for excellence scholarships; if not awarded, applicants are placed on a funding waiting list
requirements: Apply to the PhD Track program between October and January; the application period runs from October to January
No additional steps are required when applying to the PhD Track program - the admission application is reviewed by a jury for the potential award of a PhD Track scholarship
Two letters of recommendation: contact information for two referents must be provided in the application form, and an e-mail is automatically sent to them to complete a recommendation form
Applying to Master or PhD Track programs is free; IP Paris will never ask for bank details as part of an application
documents: PhD Track application submitted during the October-January application period
Two letters of recommendation submitted through the referent e-mail process
Bachelor's degree or equivalent (M1 entry), or M1 certificate of completion or equivalent (M2 entry)
selection_criteria: The best candidates are eligible for excellence scholarships
Excellent academic background and fluency in English
coverage: Master's excellence scholarship: €10,000 per year for 2 years (or 1 year)
Doctoral funding commitment with a monthly salary: total minimum gross funding of approximately €82,800 over 3 years

application_method: Apply to the PhD Track program during the October-January application period

official.international_eligibility: Open to international applicants admitted to IP Paris Master's or PhD Track programs
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: 12 PhD Track programs offered across IP Paris schools and fields including Energy, Civil Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, Applied Mathematics and Statistics, Transport/Mobility/Networks, Urban Planning and Health Engineering
official.research_requirement: Candidates must wish to become researchers; the PhD Track is a 5-year integrated Master's-to-PhD research program certifying both a Master's and a PhD (420 ECTS)
official.duration: 5 years (or 4 years): 2 Master's years followed by a 3-year PhD
official.description: The Institut Polytechnique de Paris PhD Track is a 5-year excellence program in which students spend their first two years in a Master's program with a tailored choice of courses and research internships before entering the three-year PhD program, certifying both degrees. IP Paris awards excellence scholarships each year to PhD Track students, covering their Master's years as well as doctoral funding commitments with a monthly salary.
official.program_type: Integrated 5-year Master's-to-PhD track with excellence scholarships at Institut Polytechnique de Paris
official.english_requirement: Applicants must be fluent in English

verification.notes: Direct fetches of ip-paris.fr returned transport errors on multiple attempts, so page content was read from the official domain's own published page extracts; tuition rates cited are the official MESR 2023-2024 figures the page itself flags as subject to change, hence confidence low.

applicant_utility.summary: IP Paris bundles the money into three scholarship tiers: the €10,000-per-year Master's excellence scholarship alone, a Full Package that adds a three-year doctoral funding commitment worth at least about €82,800 gross, or the doctoral-only package - and critically, every admitted PhD Track student gets tuition cut from roughly €7,000 to €243 a year whether or not they win a scholarship. There is no separate scholarship application: admission to the PhD Track puts you automatically before the jury, with unsuccessful candidates placed on a funding waiting list. The application window is October to January, and the two referee letters are triggered by contact details you supply in the form, so referees must be warned before you submit.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Research-minded Bachelor's or M1 graduates with excellent records and fluent English who want a funded five-year Master's-plus-PhD path in STEM fields at a French grande école.
application_readiness_checklist: Shortlist among the 12 PhD Track programs and check each track's own webpage for additional documents before the October-January window
Warn both referees before submitting, because the recommendation request e-mail fires automatically from the contact details in your form
Prepare a bachelor's or M1 credential set matching the entry level you are applying for
Budget time for the admission jury's reply, which can arrive up to two months after a session closes
If not awarded a scholarship, ask about remaining on the funding waiting list and about external options such as France Excellence Europa (for European students) via Campus France
common_rejection_risks: Missing the January cutoff of the October-January window, since session dates are only announced close to the time
Applying without a research intent, when the PhD Track is explicitly for future researchers
Assuming a scholarship application exists separately and therefore never checking that admission auto-triggers review
Under-preparing referees, whose forms arrive after the admissions jury has made its decision
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The Master's excellence scholarship is €10,000 per year rather than a living allowance, and tuition of €243 (years 1-2) or €380 (years 3-5) remains payable, so accommodation and daily living costs in the Paris region are not covered by the Master's scholarship itself; living support comes only through the doctoral salary phase for Full Package or Doctoral Package holders.
document_audit: Two recommendation letters are mandatory and flow from the referee contact details in the form - incomplete contact details stall the application
Entry documents differ by level: bachelor's for M1 entry, M1 completion certificate for M2 entry
Tuition figures quoted are the 2023-2024 MESR degrees indexed annually, so verify the current schedule before budgeting
alerts: IP Paris states the application itself is free and that it will never request bank details - treat any such request as fraud
Next-session dates are announced on the website rather than published in advance, so monitor the page through the window
Non-scholarship admitted students still get the tuition reduction, so a funding waiting-list place retains much of the package's value
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply to a PhD Track program during the October-January session; admission and scholarship review happen together, with the jury notifying outcomes by e-mail and unawarded candidates placed on a funding waiting list.
